title: ResourceDetails
description: Defines the fields a UI should render on the detail view of a single resource of the selected kind.

name.description: Unique name of this definition. Convention: <distribution>-<group>-<version>-<kind>, all lowercase.

selector.description: Selects the Kubernetes resource kind this definition applies to. All fields are matched exactly in v1alpha1.

apiGroup.description: API group of the target resource, e.g. 'apps' or 'tekton.dev'. The literal 'core' and the empty string are equivalent and select the Kubernetes core group.

apiVersion.description: API version of the target resource, e.g. 'v1' or 'v1beta1'.

kind.description: Kind of the target resource, e.g. 'Deployment'.

name.description: Label of the field shown to the user. Fields are merged across definitions by this name. Some names without a path are well known to renderers (Name, Namespace, Labels, Annotations, Created at, Owner, Status).

path.description: JSONPath into the rendered resource that provides the value, e.g. 'metadata.name'. The leading '$.' is optional.

type.description: How the value is rendered. Defaults to 'string'. 'table' renders a nested table described by the 'table' property.

table.description: Nested table definition, used together with type 'table' (e.g. the containers of a Pod).

name.description: Column header shown to the user.

path.description: JSONPath relative to the item rendered in each row, e.g. 'image' for a container. The leading '$.' is optional.

type.description: How the value is rendered. Defaults to 'string'.

width.description: Rendering hint for the column width. Defaults to 'default'.
